create-table-with-header-and-data-rows.title: Create Table with Header and Data Rows in PDF
create-table-with-header-and-data-rows.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically create a PDF, add a table with a styled header row, populate it with data rows, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

insert-table-into-pdf.title: Insert Table into Existing PDF Page
insert-table-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create and style a Table, position it on a specific page, and save the updated document.

auto-fit-table-columns-to-content.title: Auto‑Fit Table Columns to Content in PDF
auto-fit-table-columns-to-content.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a table, sets ColumnAdjustment to AutoFitToContent so columns resize to their cell contents, adds sample rows, and saves the modified document.

stretch-table-to-page-width.title: Stretch Table Across Page Width
stretch-table-to-page-width.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a table, and configures it to automatically fit the page width before saving the file.

insert-svg-image-into-table-cell.title: Insert SVG Image into Table Cell
insert-svg-image-into-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to embed an SVG file into a PDF by creating an Image object, adding it to a Table cell, and saving the document.

embed-html-in-table-cell.title: Embed HTML in Table Cell using HtmlFragment
embed-html-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to insert HTML markup into a PDF table cell by adding an HtmlFragment to the cell's paragraph collection.

insert-page-break-after-table-row.title: Insert Page Break After Specific Table Row
insert-page-break-after-table-row.description: Demonstrates how to create a page break within a PDF table by setting the IsInNewPage property on a row, causing subsequent rows to start on a new page.

render-table-on-new-pdf-page.title: Render Table on a New PDF Page
render-table-on-new-pdf-page.description: Shows how to create a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf, add a new page, build a table with header and data rows, and save the result.

merge-table-cells-colspan.title: Merge Table Cells Across Multiple Columns
merge-table-cells-colspan.description: Demonstrates how to merge three adjacent columns in an Aspose.Pdf table by setting the Cell.ColSpan property.

merge-table-cells-vertically-rowspan.title: Merge Table Cells Vertically Using RowSpan
merge-table-cells-vertically-rowspan.description: Shows how to merge a table cell with the cell directly below by setting the Cell.RowSpan property in an Aspose.Pdf table.

set-custom-cell-margins-in-pdf-table.title: Set Custom Cell Margins in a PDF Table
set-custom-cell-margins-in-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to configure margins for a table cell using MarginInfo and assign it to the cell's Margin property in Aspose.Pdf.

set-default-cell-padding-for-pdf-table.title: Set Default Cell Padding for a PDF Table
set-default-cell-padding-for-pdf-table.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a table, and applies uniform cell padding to all cells by setting Table.DefaultCellPadding with a MarginInfo instance.

get-rendered-table-width-after-layout.title: Get Rendered Table Width After Layout
get-rendered-table-width-after-layout.description: Loads a PDF, inserts a table, and shows how to read the calculated width of the rendered table after layout using Aspose.Pdf.

import-datatable-into-pdf-table.title: Import DataTable into PDF Table
import-datatable-into-pdf-table.description: Shows how to import an in‑memory DataTable into an Aspose.Pdf Table and save it as a PDF document.

import-filtered-dataview-into-pdf-table.title: Import Filtered DataView into PDF Table
import-filtered-dataview-into-pdf-table.description: Shows how to filter a DataTable with a DataView and import the filtered rows into an Aspose.Pdf Table, then save the result as a PDF document.

create-pdf-table-from-datatable.title: Create PDF Table from a DataTable with Aspose.Pdf
create-pdf-table-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to fill an in‑memory DataTable, import it into an Aspose.Pdf Table, and save the result as a PDF document.

check-table-break-across-pages.title: Check Table Break Across Pages
check-table-break-across-pages.description: Creates a PDF with a simple two‑column table, adds it to a page, and reads the Table.IsBroken property to determine whether the table would split across pages.

mark-table-header-enable-column-repeat.title: Mark Table Header and Enable Column Repeat
mark-table-header-enable-column-repeat.description: Shows how to mark a table column as a header and enable column repeat so the header appears on each new page, using both visual Table and tagged PDF structure for accessibility.

extract-tables-from-pdf.title: Extract Tables from PDF Using TableAbsorber
extract-tables-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to detect tables, iterate through rows, cells, and text fragments, and save the document.

replace-table-in-pdf.title: Replace Table in PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
replace-table-in-pdf.description: Shows how to locate tables on each PDF page with TableAbsorber, create a new Table, and replace the original table while keeping its position.

remove-first-table-from-pdf.title: Remove First Table from PDF using TableAbsorber
remove-first-table-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate tables in a PDF with TableAbsorber and delete the first detected table.

remove-all-tables-from-pdf.title: Remove All Tables from a PDF Document
remove-all-tables-from-pdf.description: Shows how to locate tables in a PDF using TableAbsorber and delete each absorbed table from the document.

batch-add-table-with-logo-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add Table with Company Logo to PDFs
batch-add-table-with-logo-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, insert a two‑column table containing a company logo and descriptive text on the first page of each document, and save the modified files.

batch-replace-tables-in-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Replace Tables in Multiple PDFs
batch-replace-tables-in-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over PDF files, locate each table with TableAbsorber, create a replacement Table, and replace the original tables across all documents.

apply-different-autofit-behaviors-to-tab.title: Apply Different AutoFit Behaviors to Tables in a PDF
apply-different-autofit-behaviors-to-tab.description: Demonstrates how to add multiple tables to a PDF and set distinct ColumnAdjustment (AutoFitToContent and AutoFitToWindow) for each, showing varied column sizing behavior.

set-cell-background-color-in-pdf-table.title: Set Cell Background Color in PDF Table
set-cell-background-color-in-pdf-table.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a table, and sets the background color of a specific cell to light gray.

add-solid-border-to-pdf-table.title: Add Solid Border to PDF Table
add-solid-border-to-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, create a table, apply a solid black border to the entire table, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-image-into-table-cell.title: Insert Image into a PDF Table Cell
insert-image-into-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document, add a table, and place an external image file inside a table cell using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-image-into-pdf-table-cell.title: Insert Image from Memory Stream into PDF Table Cell
insert-image-into-pdf-table-cell.description: Shows how to load an image into a memory stream and embed it into a table cell of an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-fragment-to-table-cell.title: Add TextFragment with Font and Size to a PDF Table Cell
add-text-fragment-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to insert text with a specific font and size into a table cell by creating a TextFragment, configuring its TextState, and adding it to the cell's paragraphs.

add-centered-paragraph-to-table-cell.title: Add Centered Paragraph to Table Cell
add-centered-paragraph-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and insert a paragraph into a cell with horizontal center alignment.

set-cell-vertical-alignment-middle.title: Set Cell Vertical Alignment to Middle in PDF Table
set-cell-vertical-alignment-middle.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf, add a cell containing text, and set the cell's vertical alignment to middle using the VerticalAlignment property.

center-table-horizontally.title: Center Table Horizontally in PDF
center-table-horizontally.description: Shows how to create a table, set its HorizontalAlignment to Center, and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

offset-table-left-margin.title: Offset Table from Left Margin in PDF
offset-table-left-margin.description: Demonstrates how to shift a table away from the left page margin by setting Table.Margin.Left using MarginInfo, and adds a simple two‑column table to a PDF page.

split-table-across-pdf-pages.title: Split Table Across PDF Pages with Aspose.Pdf
split-table-across-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates enabling table breaking so a large table automatically continues onto subsequent pages in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

prevent-table-splitting.title: Prevent Table Splitting Across PDF Pages
prevent-table-splitting.description: Shows how to keep an Aspose.Pdf table on a single page by setting Table.IsBroken to false and adding the table to a PDF document.

calculate-remaining-page-space-add-table.title: Calculate Remaining Page Space and Add Table to PDF
calculate-remaining-page-space-add-table.description: Demonstrates how to compute the usable vertical space on a PDF page by subtracting margins and existing content, then conditionally place a table based on the remaining space.

create-fixed-width-table-pdf.title: Create Fixed-Width Table in PDF
create-fixed-width-table-pdf.description: Shows how to set a table's total width to 500 points, add content, and save it as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-table-width-percentage.title: Set Table Width as Percentage of Page Width
set-table-width-percentage.description: Shows how to define a table's width as a percentage of the page width using Aspose.Pdf and optionally center the table on the page.

map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-table.title: Map DataTable Columns to PDF Table Using ImportDataTable
map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-table.description: Shows how to map selected DataTable columns to specific PDF table columns by building a column‑mapping dictionary and using Table.ImportDataTable.

create-pdf-table-from-filtered-dataview.title: Create PDF Table from Filtered DataView
create-pdf-table-from-filtered-dataview.description: Demonstrates filtering a DataView and manually populating an Aspose.Pdf Table to generate a PDF, avoiding the ImportDataView bug.

populate-pdf-table-from-linq-data.title: Populate PDF Table from LINQ Query via DataTable
populate-pdf-table-from-linq-data.description: Demonstrates converting a LINQ query result to a DataTable, importing it into an Aspose.Pdf Table, and saving the table in a PDF document.

add-table-to-specific-pdf-page.title: Add Table to Specific PDF Page
add-table-to-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a formatted table onto a chosen page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, including page validation, table construction, cell population, positioning, and saving.

insert-table-after-paragraph.title: Insert Table After Specific Paragraph in PDF
insert-table-after-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to locate a paragraph by its text, create a simple 2x2 table, and insert the table immediately after the found paragraph in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-before-first-image.title: Insert Table Before First Image in PDF
insert-table-before-first-image.description: Demonstrates how to locate the first image on each PDF page, create a simple 2x2 table, and insert the table before the image using Aspose.Pdf.

create-repeating-table-header.title: Create Repeating Table Header in PDF
create-repeating-table-header.description: Shows how to add a table with a header row that repeats on each new page using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API.

style-table-header-row-pdf.title: Style Table Header Row in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
style-table-header-row-pdf.description: Creates a PDF document containing a table whose header row is styled with a background color and bold font using Aspose.Pdf.

add-table-footer-to-pdf.title: Add Table Footer Row Repeated on Each PDF Page
add-table-footer-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a visual table with a footer row that repeats at the bottom of each page and how to create the corresponding logical (tagged) structure using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-table-alternating-row-colors.title: Create PDF Table with Alternating Row Colors
create-pdf-table-alternating-row-colors.description: Shows how to generate a PDF table using Aspose.Pdf and apply alternating background colors to each data row.

insert-hyperlink-into-table-cell.title: Insert Hyperlink into a Table Cell with LinkAnnotation
insert-hyperlink-into-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to add a clickable hyperlink inside a table cell by creating a LinkAnnotation, positioning it over the cell text, and saving the updated PDF.

add-checkbox-form-field-in-table-cell.title: Add Checkbox Form Field Inside Table Cell
add-checkbox-form-field-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to create a PDF with a table and place a checkbox form field inside one of the table's cells using Aspose.Pdf.

add-radio-button-group-in-table-cell.title: Add Radio Button Group Inside a Table Cell
add-radio-button-group-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to place a group of radio buttons inside a table cell by creating a RadioButtonField, adding options, and attaching it to the PDF form.

export-pdf-table-structure-to-json.title: Export PDF Table Structure to JSON
export-pdf-table-structure-to-json.description: Shows how to extract the logical table structure from a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterate rows and cells, and serialize their properties into a JSON file.

export-pdf-table-to-csv.title: Export PDF Table Data to CSV
export-pdf-table-to-csv.description: Shows how to extract tables from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber and write each cell's text to a CSV file with proper escaping.

serialize-pdf-table-to-xml.title: Serialize PDF Table to XML
serialize-pdf-table-to-xml.description: Shows how to create a PDF table from a DataTable, save the PDF, then read the table back and serialize its rows and cells into an XML document.

render-xml-table-to-pdf.title: Render XML-defined Table to PDF
render-xml-table-to-pdf.description: The example reads a table layout from an XML file, builds a DataTable, and uses Aspose.Pdf to create a PDF document with the table rendered on a page.

count-tables-in-pdf.title: Count Tables in PDF using TableAbsorber
count-tables-in-pdf.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate and count tables in a PDF document.

extract-table-coordinates-from-pdf.title: Extract Table Coordinates from PDF
extract-table-coordinates-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to locate tables in a PDF and retrieve their bounding rectangle coordinates using Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber.

extract-text-from-pdf-tables.title: Extract Text from PDF Tables Using TableAbsorber
extract-text-from-pdf-tables.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate tables with TableAbsorber, iterate through rows and cells, and concatenate the text fragments inside each cell.

replace-text-in-pdf-table-cells.title: Replace Text in PDF Table Cells
replace-text-in-pdf-table-cells.description: Shows how to locate tables in a PDF, find cells that contain a specific keyword, and replace the cell text using Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber and TextFragment classes.

remove-column-from-pdf-table.title: Remove a Column from a PDF Table
remove-column-from-pdf-table.description: Shows how to delete a specific column from a table in a PDF by removing the corresponding Cell objects from each Row using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-new-column-into-pdf-table.title: Insert New Column into PDF Table
insert-new-column-into-pdf-table.description: Shows how to add a new column to each row of a table in a PDF by inserting a Cell at a specified zero‑based index using Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-table-columns.title: Reorder PDF Table Columns
reorder-pdf-table-columns.description: Demonstrates extracting a table from a PDF, rebuilding it with a custom column order, and replacing the original table using Aspose.Pdf.

adjust-table-column-widths-proportionall.title: Adjust Table Column Widths Proportionally in PDF
adjust-table-column-widths-proportionall.description: Shows how to compute the total width of a table's columns, convert each width to a percentage of that total, and apply the proportional widths to a PDF table using Aspose.Pdf.

set-minimum-column-width.title: Set Minimum Column Width for PDF Table
set-minimum-column-width.description: Demonstrates how to enforce a minimum column width in a PDF table by using the Table.DefaultColumnWidth property and optionally defining explicit column widths with Aspose.Pdf.

set-maximum-table-column-width.title: Limit Table Column Widths in PDF
set-maximum-table-column-width.description: Demonstrates how to set a default column width and explicit column widths to prevent table columns from expanding beyond a specified point measurement in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-auto-numbered-column-to-pdf-table.title: Add Auto‑Numbered Column to PDF Table
add-auto-numbered-column-to-pdf-table.description: Shows how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and fill the first column with sequential numbers using the Table.ImportArray method.

add-table-with-semi-transparent-backgrou.title: Add Table with Semi-Transparent Background to PDF
add-table-with-semi-transparent-backgrou.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a table, and set the table's background color with opacity using Aspose.Pdf.

add-table-with-background-color.title: Add Table with Background Color to PDF
add-table-with-background-color.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, inserting a table, and applying a solid background color while noting that gradient backgrounds are not supported via the Table.BackgroundColor property.

set-table-z-index.title: Set Table Z-Index to Control Overlap in PDF
set-table-z-index.description: Demonstrates how to assign a ZIndex value to a Table so it renders above other page elements such as a background rectangle in an Aspose.Pdf document.

insert-table-into-paragraph-collection.title: Insert Table into Paragraph Collection in PDF
insert-table-into-paragraph-collection.description: Shows how to add a TextFragment and then insert a Table as a paragraph into a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

import-images-from-datatable-into-pdf-ta.title: Import Images from DataTable into a PDF Table
import-images-from-datatable-into-pdf-ta.description: Demonstrates how to load image byte arrays from a DataTable, create Image objects, and place them into cells of an Aspose.Pdf Table, then save the result as a PDF.

render-table-high-dpi-images.title: Render Table with High‑DPI Images
render-table-high-dpi-images.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF table with images and saving it as HTML using a higher ImageResolution to produce high‑DPI output.

create-pdf-report-multiple-tables.title: Create PDF Report with Multiple Tables
create-pdf-report-multiple-tables.description: Demonstrates building a PDF document that contains several tables, each imported from a DataTable representing data from different databases.

create-pdf-table-dynamic-row-count.title: Create PDF Table with Dynamic Row Count
create-pdf-table-dynamic-row-count.description: Demonstrates building a DataTable at runtime, importing it into an Aspose.Pdf.Table, and saving the PDF with a dynamically sized table.

conditional-formatting-table-cells.title: Conditional Formatting of Table Cells in PDF
conditional-formatting-table-cells.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf, add data rows, and apply background colors to cells when numeric values exceed defined thresholds.

rotate-text-in-table-cell.title: Rotate Text Inside a Table Cell
rotate-text-in-table-cell.description: Creates a PDF, adds a table with a single cell, and rotates the text inside that cell by setting the TextFragment's TextState.Rotation property.

rotate-table-90-degrees-pdf.title: Render a 90° Rotated Table in a PDF
rotate-table-90-degrees-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a table from a DataTable, adding it to a PDF page, and rotating the entire page (including the table) by 90 degrees using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-merged-cells-in-pdf-tables.title: Detect Merged Cells in PDF Tables Using TableAbsorber
detect-merged-cells-in-pdf-tables.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber with the FlowEngine to find tables that contain merged cells by examining each cell's ColSpan and RowSpan values.

replace-merged-table-cells.title: Replace Merged Table Cells with Separate Cells
replace-merged-table-cells.description: Shows how to use TableAbsorber to detect merged cells in a PDF table, split them into individual cells, and insert a new table without merged spans.

add-footnote-references-to-table-cells.title: Add Footnote References to Table Cells in PDF
add-footnote-references-to-table-cells.description: Shows how to insert superscript footnote markers inside table cells, attach Aspose.Pdf footnote notes, and save the updated PDF.

insert-table-at-specific-position.title: Insert Table at Specific Position in PDF
insert-table-at-specific-position.description: Demonstrates how to add an Aspose.Pdf.Table to an existing PDF page and position it at exact X/Y coordinates using MarginInfo.

right-align-table-pdf.title: Right Align Table in PDF
right-align-table-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to align a table to the right margin of a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf by setting the table's Alignment property and optionally adjusting its left coordinate.

set-table-border-thickness.title: Set Table Border Thickness in PDF
set-table-border-thickness.description: Shows how to create a PDF table with a 2‑point border using Aspose.Pdf, including column widths, cell padding, and adding header and data rows.

apply-double-border-to-pdf-table.title: Apply Double Border to PDF Table
apply-double-border-to-pdf-table.description: Creates a PDF with a 3x3 table and sets a double‑border effect by configuring BorderInfo with width and color.

add-multiline-text-to-table-cell.title: Add Multiline Text to Table Cell in PDF
add-multiline-text-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to insert multiline text into a PDF table cell by adding separate TextFragment objects and a line‑break fragment.

add-list-items-in-table-cell.title: Add List Items Inside a Table Cell
add-list-items-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to create a bullet list within a PDF table cell by adding TextFragment paragraphs with list markers.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Tables to CSV using TableAbsorber
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to locate tables in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber and export each table to a separate CSV file, handling cell text and proper CSV escaping.

extract-pdf-tables-to-datatable.title: Extract PDF Tables into DataTable with TableAbsorber
extract-pdf-tables-to-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to read tables from a PDF and populate them into .NET DataTable objects, including creating a sample PDF if needed.

set-custom-row-height-in-pdf-table.title: Set Custom Row Height in PDF Table
set-custom-row-height-in-pdf-table.description: Shows how to create a PDF document with a table and assign a fixed height to a specific row using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

auto-fit-table-row-height.title: Auto‑Fit Table Row Height in PDF
auto-fit-table-row-height.description: Demonstrates how to let a table row automatically adjust its height to fit wrapped cell content by leaving FixedRowHeight unset and setting MinRowHeight to zero.

set-fixed-row-height-for-pdf-table-rows.title: Set Fixed Row Height for PDF Table Rows
set-fixed-row-height-for-pdf-table-rows.description: Shows how to create a PDF table and enforce a fixed height for each row using Aspose.Pdf in C#.

render-wide-table-landscape.title: Render Wide Table in Landscape Orientation
render-wide-table-landscape.description: Demonstrates setting a PDF page to landscape orientation and adding a wide table that fits the page using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-page-add-table.title: Rotate PDF Page and Add Table
rotate-page-add-table.description: Shows how to rotate a PDF page 90 degrees clockwise and insert a simple two‑column table onto the rotated page using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-extract-tables-rotated-pages.title: Detect and Extract Tables on Rotated PDF Pages
detect-extract-tables-rotated-pages.description: Demonstrates checking each page's rotation angle and using TableAbsorber to locate and enumerate tables on rotated PDF pages.

remove-tables-containing-keyword.title: Remove Tables Containing a Keyword from a PDF
remove-tables-containing-keyword.description: Demonstrates how to locate tables in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber, scan each cell for a specific keyword, and delete the matching tables before saving the document.
